category_labels.A: Must be complete before Mechanical Completion
category_labels.B: Must be complete before Ready for Commissioning
category_labels.C: Must be complete before Handover / final acceptance

steps.description: Packing list verified against purchase order
Nameplate data recorded and matches datasheet
Weld map complete, NDE reports attached
Supports, guides and spring hangers set
Test package approved and boundaries isolated
No leakage or pressure drop observed
Foundation, grout and anchor bolts accepted
Lubrication system filled with correct grade
Impulse lines leak tested and sloped
Service leak test at operating pressure
Control loops in automatic and tuned
